gdpr.title: Data protection (GDPR)
gdpr.description: Right of access (Art. 15) and right to erasure (Art. 17).

anonymize.title: Anonymise customer (Art. 17)
anonymize.erased: Erased: name, e-mail, phone, address, company, account and sessions, marketing consent; on orders the contact data, notes, IP address and cart session; attendee names on tickets and the stored ticket files; recipients, subjects and stored variables of the e-mail log; payer name and IBAN of completed refunds; PayPal payer details in payment records and in stored webhook payloads; names, e-mails and free-text reasons in the order history; e-mail addresses on access-code redemptions. This cannot be undone.
anonymize.kept: Kept (legal retention, Art. 17(3)(b) GDPR, tax law): invoices and credit notes with their buyer data and PDFs; name, company and billing address on orders that have invoices until {years} years after the end of the invoice year (then erased automatically); bank statement data (counterparty name, IBAN, purpose); order numbers, items, amounts, payment and refund records, ticket codes and check-in records without names; webhook event ids, types, amounts and status; the audit trail (contains no personal values).
anonymize.openOrder: open order – cancel it or wait for payment/expiry first
anonymize.futureTickets: {count, plural, one {# valid ticket} other {# valid tickets}} for "{event}" on {date} – cancel the tickets first
anonymize.openRefund: open refund of {amount} – complete it first (the payer account is still needed)
anonymize.cancelFirst: Cancel the orders or complete the refunds, then come back.
anonymize.confirmLabel: Type the e-mail address of the customer ({email}) to confirm

settings.title: Data retention
settings.description: Retention periods for personal data outside the accounting records (daily job).
settings.emailRetentionDaysHint: Stored e-mail variables and subjects of delivered e-mails are erased after this time. 0 = keep.
settings.invoiceRetentionYearsHint: Billing data of anonymised customers stays on orders with invoices until this many years after the end of the invoice year.
settings.webhookRetentionDaysHint: Payer name, e-mail and address inside stored PayPal webhook payloads are erased after this time (ids, type, amount and status stay). 0 = keep.
